top_signals.title: Nextdc Investor UniSuper Says ‘Not That Keen’ on Data Centers
top_signals.summary: One of Australia’s top pension funds is steering clear of direct investments in data centers, arguing the biggest winners from the artificial intelligence boom will ultimately be the companies that harness the technology rather than those building the infrastructure behind it.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Pentagon AI oversight office struggles to keep pace with department’s ambitions, GAO finds
top_signals.summary: The Pentagon office tapped in 2022 to oversee the military’s responsible use of AI had filled just three of 10 authorized positions as of February 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
